name: @red-cup-engineering/derive-set-of-fill-transactions-service
description: Derives Beancount transactions for a chronologically ordered set of venue fills: a FIFO cost-basis lot per custody-account/base-commodity pair opened on each buy with Beancount total-cost `{{...}}` syntax, consumed exactly on each sell with the realized gain or loss posted against the settled proceeds, a separate fee posting when a fill's fee is not already netted into its settled amount, and a refusal (never a booking) for any fill whose supplied witness nodes disagree.
